name: ro-payroll-social
description: Use this skill to run Romanian payroll for tax year 2026: registering employees in REGES ONLINE (the successor to REVISAL) the day before they start, the monthly gross-to-net (employee pension contribution CAS 25%, health contribution CASS 10%, income tax 10% after the personal deduction), the minimum gross wage (RON 4,050 to 30 June 2026, RON 4,325 from 1 July 2026), the tax-free RON 300 then RON 200 a month for full-time minimum-wage staff under OUG 89/2025, the employer work insurance contribution (CAM 2.25%), meal vouchers and other non-taxable benefits, the minimum CAS and CASS on part-time contracts, D112 filing and payment by the 25th, quarterly filers, annual duties and penalties. Trigger phrases: salarizare, stat de plata, D112, CAM, salariul minim 2026, tichete de masa, REGES, Romanian payroll, employer cost Romania. Out of scope: self-employed CAS and CASS (ro-cas-cass), the employee's own income tax questions and other income (ro-employee-income-tax, ro-income-tax), residen
